resolution: Each result uses exactly one sense. STMT-STRONG-VERIFICATION-EXCLUDES-LAWS concerns conclusive verification (V1) only; STMT-AYER-1936-CRITERION-TRIVIAL the unrestricted 1936 test (V2); STMT-CHURCH-1949-TRIVIALIZATION and its corollaries the 1946 direct and indirect clauses (V3). No result transfers a verdict from one sense to another: a sentence not conclusively verifiable may pass the 1936 or 1946 test, which is why the weaker criteria were proposed. The self-application premises (STMT-VERIFICATION-PRINCIPLE-NOT-VERIFIABLE) take the variant's own sense as a parameter.
